name: Contact Entity IV
body:
Contact Entity IV
Source Horror Adventures pg. 114
School evocation; Level arcanist 7, cleric 7, medium 4, occultist 6, oracle 7, psychic 7, shaman 7, sorcerer 7, summoner 6, summoner (unchained) 6, witch 7, wizard 7
Casting
Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, M (see text)
Effect
Range 500 miles
Target up to 20 entities of 24 HD or fewer
Duration instantaneous
Description
This spell functions like contact entity III, except that you can contact creatures from the contact entity IV list, and as noted above.
